description: This file defines the SetNonpkFields class which implements a specific method operation for the MiniLang language in the OFBiz framework. It sets non-primary key fields on an Entity (GenericValue) based on parameters from XML configuration, primarily used in data manipulation tasks within the mini-language processing.

classes.name: SetNonpkFields
classes.description: Implements the method operation for setting non-primary key fields on an entity based on XML configuration.

classes.name: SetNonpkFields.SetNonpkFieldsFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of SetNonpkFields from XML elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation to set non-PK fields on an entity value based on the environment map.

methods.description: Returns a string representation of the XML element as constructed for debugging.
